statement: Wynn Resorts, Limited's adjusted Property EBITDAR at Wynn Macau decreased $47.0 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025.
The decrease in adjusted Property EBITDAR at Wynn Macau was primarily due to a combined decrease in casino revenues of $100.1 million.
The decrease in adjusted Property EBITDAR at Wynn Macau was partially offset by a decrease in gaming tax expense.
Wynn Resorts, Limited's adjusted Property EBITDAR at Las Vegas Operations decreased $22.9 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025.
The decrease in adjusted Property EBITDAR at Las Vegas Operations was primarily due to higher operating expenses and a decrease in non-gaming revenues of $37.1 million.
Wynn Resorts, Limited's adjusted Property EBITDAR at Encore Boston Harbor decreased $5.7 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025.

NRG Energy, Inc. entered into a definitive agreement on May 12, 2025, to acquire a power portfolio including 13 GW of natural gas-fired generation facilities and the C&I VPP platform with 6 GW of capacity from LS Power.
The acquisition consideration includes 24.25 million shares of NRG common stock, $6.4 billion in cash, and the assumption of $3.2 billion of debt, in addition to working capital.
NRG expects to fund the acquisition using a combination of newly-issued secured and unsecured debt, equity issuance, and cash on hand.
CME Group Inc.'s energy contract volumes increased in the second quarter of 2024 compared with the same period in 2023.
The increase in energy contract volumes was attributed to higher overall market volatility.
Natural gas volatility was higher in Q2 2024 due to uncertain weather conditions in the U.S.
Crude oil volatility was slightly higher in Q2 2024 due to geopolitical issues in the Middle East and U.S.-China economic uncertainty.
Microsoft Corporation's Xbox hardware revenue decreased 13% in FY2024 compared to FY2023 due to lower console sales volume.
Microsoft's Search and News advertising revenue increased $418 million or 3% in FY2024, with a 12% increase excluding traffic acquisition costs.
Microsoft's Devices revenue decreased $815 million or 15% in FY2024.
Microsoft's operating income increased $2.9 billion or 17% in FY2024.
Microsoft's gross margin increased $6.8 billion or 23% in FY2024, driven by growth in Gaming and the Activision Blizzard acquisition.
Microsoft's Research and Development expenses increased $2.3 billion or 9% in FY2024, primarily due to Gaming and the Activision Blizzard acquisition.
Apple Inc.'s iPad net sales decreased 17% in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the second quarter of 2023.
Apple Inc.'s iPad net sales decreased 22% in the first six months of 2024 compared to the first six months of 2023.
Teradyne, Inc.'s Semiconductor Test systems performance in the third quarter of 2024 was driven by System-on-a-chip in compute and memory by DRAM and high bandwidth memory.
Teradyne, Inc. expects compute and memory to continue driving meaningful demand in the fourth quarter of 2024.
Teradyne, Inc.'s Robotics segment includes Universal Robots A/S and Mobile Industrial Robots A/S.
Expedia Group expanded into the alternative accommodations market through Vrbo, which specializes in unique whole home inventory primarily in North American leisure markets.

Vrbo transitioned from a listings-based classified advertising model to an online transactional model to optimize for travelers and partners, with a focus on increasing monetization through marketing and product/technology investments.
Vrbo generates revenue primarily through a pay-per-booking service model and traveler service fees, along with insurance products.
American Tower Corporation's principal executive officer and principal financial officer concluded that disclosure controls and procedures were effective as of September 30, 2024.
There were no material changes in American Tower Corporation's internal control over financial reporting during the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2024.
Lockheed Martin Corporation delivered 992 production F-35 aircraft through June 30, 2024, including 710 F-35A variants, 197 F-35B variants, and 85 F-35C variants.
Lockheed Martin Corporation expects to deliver between 75 and 110 F-35 aircraft in the second half of FY2024, primarily in the Technology Refresh 3 (TR-3) configuration.

Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. is engaged in a legal dispute with the NBA regarding the renewal of its existing license to distribute NBA games, which will expire at the end of the 2024-2025 NBA season.
The nonrenewal of the NBA license could limit Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.'s ability to negotiate higher rates for the distribution of its networks.

Vistra Corp. expects to write off approximately $400 million of plant value to depreciation expense in the first quarter of 2025 for the Moss Landing 300 battery energy storage facility due to a fire in January 2025.
The Moss Landing 300 battery facility is part of a complex with an aggregate book value of approximately $1 billion, including two other battery facilities and a gas plant.
Vistra Corp. experienced a fire at Unit 1 of its Martin Lake facility in ERCOT on November 27, 2024, with depreciation expense associated with the damaged property being less than $1 million.
CSX Corporation's interest income increased from 2023 to 2024 primarily as a result of higher average interest rates.
American Water Works Company, Inc. has purchase premiums recoverable through rates that are being recovered over periods up to 40 years.
Assurant, Inc.'s Global Lifestyle net earned premiums, fees and other income increased $74.6 million, or 4%, to $2.18 billion for Second Quarter 2024 compared to Second Quarter 2023.
The increase in Global Lifestyle net earned premiums, fees and other income was primarily driven by Connected Living from mobile growth.
Lam Research Corporation's revenue increased 8% in the September 2024 quarter compared to the June 2024 quarter.

The revenue increase was driven by increases in systems revenue due to strengthened investments in the dynamic random access memory ("DRAM") market segment and increases in customer support-related revenue.
The deferred revenue balance increased to $2,047.0 million at the end of the September 2024 quarter, primarily due to an increase in customer advanced deposits.
Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s mortgage segment generated $252 million of underwriting income in the 2025 first quarter.
The mortgage segment's in-force U.S. primary mortgage insurance portfolio had a persistency rate of 81.9% in the 2025 first quarter.
LyondellBasell Industries N.V.'s effective income tax rate for the first quarter of 2025 was 61.0%, compared to 20.3% for the first quarter of 2024.

The increase in LyondellBasell's effective tax rate in Q1 2025 was partly due to the discrete tax recognition of foreign exchange gains and losses with lower pre-tax earnings, which increased the rate by 39.3 percentage points.

Cboe Global Markets, Inc.'s Derivatives markets revenue includes transaction and clearing fees, market data fees related to U.S. tape plans, regulatory fees, and other revenue from Options, Futures, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Digital segments.

Cboe Global Markets, Inc.'s cash and spot markets revenue includes transaction and clearing fees, market data fees related to U.S. tape plans, regulatory fees, and other revenue from North American Equities, Europe, Asia Pacific, Global FX, and Digital segments.
Cboe Data Vantage business generates revenue from access and capacity fees, proprietary market data fees, licensing agreements, proprietary indices, and other data and access products and services.
VALERO ENERGY CORP reported $2.8 billion of net income attributable to Valero stockholders for the year ended December 31, 2024.
VALERO ENERGY CORP's operating results for 2024 included $6.7 billion of cash generated from operations.
Visa Inc. funded the U.S. litigation escrow account by $1.5 billion in FY2024.
Eaton Corporation plc's Electrical Americas and Electrical Global segments had 26% of sales to eight large customers in 2024.
Eaton Corporation plc's Aerospace segment had 23% of sales to four large original equipment manufacturers of aircraft in 2024.
Eaton Corporation plc's Vehicle segment had 28% of sales to two large original equipment manufacturers of vehicles and related components in 2024.
Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated reported $2.65 billion in CF product revenue in Q2 FY2024.
Yum! Brands, Inc.'s Company sales increased 10% in FY2025 Q1 compared with FY2024 Q1, excluding foreign currency translation impacts.
The increase in Company sales was partially attributed to the KFC U.K. and Ireland restaurant acquisition and 2% same-store sales growth.
NRG Energy, Inc. increased its annual common stock dividend to $1.76 per share in the first quarter of 2025, representing an 8% increase from 2024.
Nasdaq’s Index business achieved a record in Index ETP AUM of $575 billion during the third quarter of 2024, averaging $575 billion and reaching $600 billion at quarter-end.
Nasdaq’s Index business contributed to 2% ARR growth and 9% revenue growth in the third quarter of 2024, fueled by strong index performance.
Wynn Resorts, Limited contributed $356.5 million of cash into Island 3 during the second quarter of 2024, bringing life-to-date cash contributions to $514.4 million.

The Company estimates its remaining 40% pro-rata share of the required equity for the Wynn Al Marjan Island development is approximately $900 million, inclusive of capitalized interest, fees, and certain improvements.
Lockheed Martin’s MFC business segment was awarded a competitively bid classified contract with a cost-reimbursable base contract and multiple fixed price options for additional phases.
Lockheed Martin recognized a $100 million reach forward loss in the first quarter of 2024 due to the probable exercise of an option under the classified contract.
The cumulative losses recognized on the MFC program, including precontract costs, reached approximately $150 million by the end of the first quarter of 2024.
News Corporation's total revenues increased $78 million, or 3%, for the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the corresponding period of fiscal 2024.

The revenue increase was driven by higher revenues at the Digital Real Estate Services segment, primarily due to higher Australian residential revenues at REA Group, and at the Book Publishing segment, primarily due to higher digital book sales and improved returns in the U.S., and at the Dow Jones segment driven by higher professional information business revenues, and at the Subscription Video Services segment primarily due to higher streaming revenues and the positive impact of foreign currency fluctuations, partially offset by lower residential subscription revenues and lower revenues at the News Media segment driven by the transfer of third-party printing revenue contracts to News UK’s joint venture with DMG Media in fiscal 2024 and lower advertising and circulation and subscription revenues.
Foreign currency fluctuations resulted in a revenue increase of $35 million, or 1%, for the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the corresponding period of fiscal 2024.
Borg Warner Inc. made the decision to exit its charging business within the Battery & Charging Systems reportable segment in February 2025.
The exit of the charging business is expected to be substantially completed during the second quarter of 2025.

WEC Energy Group, Inc. plans to achieve net-zero methane emissions in its natural gas distribution operations by the end of 2030 through operational improvements, equipment upgrades, and the use of RNG throughout its systems.
WEC Energy Group, Inc. has contracts in place for 1.9 Bcf of RNG to replace higher-emission methane in its natural gas distribution systems.
WEC Energy Group, Inc. began transporting RNG from local dairy farms onto its natural gas distribution systems in Wisconsin in 2023.
Eaton Corporation plc acquired Fibrebond Corporation on April 1, 2025, which is part of its Electrical Americas business segment.

Expedia Group, Inc. launched One Key in the United States in 2023 as a unified loyalty program under Brand Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo, enabling cross-earning and cross-redeeming of rewards across brands and products such as air, hotels, and alternative accommodations.
Expedia Group plans to roll out One Key in the United Kingdom in 2024.
CME Group Inc. offers clearing services for OTC interest rate swaps, FX forwards, and commodity swaps in addition to its listed futures and options.
CME Group Inc. expanded its SPAN 2 margin framework to equity products in 2024.
Insulet Corporation revised the estimated liability for voluntary medical device correction notices (MDCs) by $10.7 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2023.
The revision to the MDC liability primarily resulted from lower shipping costs for replacement DASH PDMs and lower expected distribution costs for Omnipod 5 Controllers.
3M Company's Home improvement business segment led the way up low-single digits in FY2024, driven by strength during the holiday season for Command, Scotch Tapes, and Paint Protection products.
Verisk Analytics, Inc. uses year-over-year revenue growth as a key performance metric to assess its performance.
Verisk Analytics, Inc. assesses revenue growth based on increased sales to existing customers, sales to new customers, sales of new or expanded solutions, and strategic acquisitions.
Abbott Laboratories' Core Laboratory Diagnostics sales increased 4.5% excluding COVID-19 testing-related sales in the first nine months of 2024.
M&T Bank Corporation conducts quarterly reviews of criticized commercial and industrial loans and commercial real estate loans greater than $5 million to assess loan grades and accrual status.
The Company performs targeted loan reviews in segments of loan portfolios experiencing heightened credit risk due to economic conditions.

In FY2024 Q2, M&T Bank Corporation focused targeted loan reviews on investor-owned commercial real estate loans, including construction loans, with emphasis on criticized loans and near-term maturities.
OCCIDENTAL PETROLEUM CORP /DE/ reported that the average daily price per barrel of WTI crude decreased to $75.72 in 2024 from $77.64 in 2023.
OCCIDENTAL PETROLEUM CORP /DE/ reported that the average daily Brent price per barrel decreased to $79.79 in 2024 from $82.25 in 2023.
OCCIDENTAL PETROLEUM CORP /DE/ reported that the average daily NYMEX natural gas price per MMcf decreased to $2.34 in 2024 from $2.94 in 2023.

Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc. has collective bargaining agreements covering represented employees, with most expiring in March 2026 and approximately 15 Mission Technologies employees in Klamath Falls, Oregon covered by an agreement expiring in June 2025.
The company has not experienced a work stoppage in more than 25 years at Newport News and more than 17 years at Ingalls.
Masco Corporation acquired Sauna360 Group Oy in the third quarter of 2023 for approximately €124 million ($136 million), net of cash acquired.
The Sauna360 acquisition is included within Masco Corporation’s Plumbing Products segment.
The acquisition resulted in $22 million of indefinite-lived intangible assets related to trademarks and $45 million of definite-lived intangible assets related to customer relationships.
The definite-lived intangible assets from the Sauna360 acquisition are being amortized on a straight-line basis over a weighted average period of 16 years.
Masco Corporation recognized $60 million of goodwill related to the Sauna360 acquisition, which is not tax deductible.
The goodwill allocation for the Sauna360 acquisition was adjusted by $1 million in the fourth quarter of 2023 and $2 million in the third quarter of 2024.
Mohawk Industries, Inc.'s Flooring Rest of the World net sales were $670 million for the three months ended March 29, 2025.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. acquired Noggin, a global provider of critical event management software, for $91 million net of cash acquired on July 1, 2024.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. acquired a company providing vehicle location and management solutions for $132 million net of cash acquired on July 1, 2024.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. acquired Silent Sentinel, a provider of specialized long-range cameras, for $37 million net of cash acquired on February 13, 2024.
Fidelity National Information Services, Inc.'s Banking segment revenue increased 2% for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to 2023.
Recurring revenue contributed 3% to the Banking segment's total revenue growth rate in FY2024.
Phillips 66’s composite 3:2:1 market crack spread decreased to an average of $16.50 per barrel in FY2024 Q3 compared with $36.06 per barrel in FY2024 Q3 of the prior year.

CarMax, Inc. anticipates opening six locations in fiscal 2024, including two in the New York metro market, one each in Los Angeles and Chicago, and its first stand-alone reconditioning center in Atlanta.
CarMax, Inc. estimates capital expenditures will total approximately $450 million in fiscal 2024, up from $422.7 million in fiscal 2023.

Vistra Corp. manages commodity price risk related to electricity, natural gas, and other energy-related products through portfolio optimization of generation assets, fuel supply, and retail sales load.
Texas Instruments Incorporated received a cash benefit of $588 million from the U.S. CHIPS and Science Act investment tax credit in 2024.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's capital expenditures in 2024 were $4.82 billion, primarily for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and facilities.
